description:
One of the most dangerous financial trades in the world is starting to unwind, and most investors have no idea how exposed they are.

For years, Wall Street borrowed ultra-cheap Japanese yen and poured that money into higher-yielding U.S. assets. This became known as the yen carry trade.
As long as Japanese interest rates stayed near zero and the yen remained weak, the strategy worked. But that relationship is changing.
Japan is raising rates, domestic bond yields are climbing, and the yen has become increasingly unstable. That makes borrowing in Japan less attractive and forces leveraged investors to unwind positions, selling U.S. stocks, Treasuries, crypto, and other assets to repay yen-denominated loans. We already saw what that can look like during the violent market selloff of August 2024. Now the trade may be even more dangerous.

title: Most Terrifying Financial Shift in the World Right Now

description:
Some of the craziest Dark Web conspiracies weren’t conspiracies at all. For years, criminals believed Tor, Bitcoin, and hidden marketplaces could make them virtually impossible to trace. But behind the anonymity was a very different reality.

Police have secretly taken control of entire Dark Web marketplaces. Cryptocurrency transactions once thought anonymous have been reconstructed years later. Hidden services have exposed their real servers through simple coding mistakes. And some of the technology behind the Dark Web itself was originally developed by researchers working for the U.S. government.
From fake hitman markets and actual online contract killings to AlphaBay, Hansa, massive healthcare-data thefts, blockchain investigations, suspicious Tor relays, and billions of dollars in stolen cryptocurrency, the supposed “lawless frontier” has repeatedly proven far less anonymous than its users believed.
